dif.summary: Ensure the intended payment reaches one correct terminal outcome without an unintended duplicate financial action.

allowed_paths: recover or read the existing transaction state
blocked_paths: blindly issue a new non-idempotent payment while prior commit state is unknown
constraints: the original commit state is unknown

drp.decision_summary: Recover prior operation state before authorizing another financial commit.

tip.action_summary: Perform the contract-defined recovery or read operation before any new financial commit.
